description: Read any resolved brand's free public AI visibility evidence. Returns a compact summary by default; request a section for markets, topics, perception, rivals, questions, sources, history or family. Use a returned slug; preserve each metric's unit and date window. The data is the same public evidence shown on Parse's website, not private workspace tracking; absent measurements are not zero.

offset.description: Use the next offset returned by this tool for the same section.

slug_or_id.description: The brand's slug as parse_check_brand returned it, or its fetch id from parse_search, for example stripe-com or brand:stripe-com.

name: parse_get_brand
title: Get brand AI visibility brief
